## File: berriai_litellm/cookbook/veo_video_generation.py

Prompts

```
['generate a video from a text prompt using Google Veo model via LiteLLM proxy', 'poll a long-running video generation operation until it completes and return the video URI', "download a generated video file from Google's storage URI to a local MP4 file", 'run the full workflow to generate a video from a text prompt and download it locally', 'run the Veo video generation example script with a sample prompt through LiteLLM proxy']
```

